title: Minimax Estimation of Treatment-Effect Variance with Labeled Trials and Unlabeled Covariates on Discrete Cells
banked_reason: D0.5 review: tier incremental, below field floor; exact global VCATE minimax frontier and matching estimator remain open.
gap_reasons: It does not deliver the advertised global minimax rate, matching achievability over intermediate occupancies, or the necessary-and-sufficient phase thresholds; those central outputs remain explicitly open in global-frontier and certificate-duality.
the broader theorem is only a lower curve paired with a loose inverse-count upper bound.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived legal full-experiment lower priors, a lower interpolation through unit occupancy, a matched unit-occupancy exponent, an auxiliary-registry order improvement, and fixed-dimensional boundary inference. D0.5 found the mathematics sound but the global minimax target undelivered: matching achievability, certificate duality, and necessary-and-sufficient phase thresholds remain open. A future retry needs a new intermediate-occupancy upper and duality argument rather than another specialization of the existing lower prior.
tldr: With \(n\) randomized labeled records and \(m\) baseline-only records on \(d\) near-uniform cells, causal VCATE is identified as \(V=\operatorname{Var}\{E[Y(1)-Y(0)\mid X]\}\). The signed response reduces estimation to a shared-mass marked quadratic functional. A complete-experiment parity construction now yields the explicit lower interpolation \(R_{C,\epsilon}(n,m,d)\ge c_\epsilon\exp[-K\log d/\log\{(d/N)\log d\}]\) for every even \(d\) and \(N=n+m\le d\). It recovers constant risk throughout every fixed polynomially sublinear registry and the stretched-exponential unit-occupancy scale; at \(N=d\), a total polynomial estimator supplies the matching exponent-scale upper bound. A verified high-registry estimator reaches the known-mass order along \(d\asymp n^{3/2}\) once \(m\gtrsim d\log n\). The matching upper frontier between these checkpoints, exact phase thresholds, and constant-factor certificate duality remain open; fixed-alphabet boundary inference is a separate companion result.
gap: Regular semisupervised causal-VCATE theory assumes positive first-order variance, while discrete-functional estimators do not resolve the shared unknown marginal and two outcome marks of this randomized experiment. No inspected source gives a numerical minimax frontier uniform in \(n,m,d\), and even the unit-occupancy same-experiment converse remains open.
fill: The project proves a reciprocal-polynomial upper envelope and its stretched-exponential unit-occupancy upper rate using a fully specified deterministic split and certificate-minimizing polynomial, asks for explicit common-marginal mixing measures with complete-experiment affinity control at that checkpoint, extends the resulting duality to the full phase diagram, and derives fixed-alphabet boundary inference from observable counts.
